stem: Which prescription scenarios can use the special federal Schedule II partial-filling pathway for LTCF residents or terminally ill patients, assuming the other requirements are met? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Oxycodone Schedule II for a routine outpatient with neither LTCF nor terminal status, relying only on this special pathway
Methylphenidate Schedule II for an LTCF resident
Morphine Schedule II for a terminally ill patient
Oxycodone Schedule II for an LTCF resident
Alprazolam Schedule IV for an LTCF resident

explanation.core_reasoning: The LTCF/terminal pathway is available for Schedule II prescriptions based on patient status and is not limited to opioid/narcotic C-II drugs.

choice_analysis.B: The LTCF pathway is not narcotic-limited.
choice_analysis.C: Terminal status activates the special C-II pathway.
choice_analysis.D: This C-II LTCF prescription can qualify.
choice_analysis.E: This particular special rule is for Schedule II prescriptions.

related_facts: The special framework includes a 60-day limit from issue unless discontinued sooner.
explanation.mpje_trap: Assuming only C-II opioids qualify or every LTCF controlled drug uses the same rule.

reasoning_steps: Apply the special C-II partial-fill rule
